passages.text: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. So Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria to the officials of Jezreel, to the elders, and to the guardians of the sons of Ahab, saying: “When this letter arrives, since your master’s sons are with you and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city and weaponry, select the best and most worthy son of your master, set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.”
passages.sermon:
Ahab was king of Israel.
Ahab had seventy sons.
These sons lived in Samaria.
Jehu was a commander in Israel.
Jehu wrote letters.
Jehu sent these letters to Samaria.
He sent them to the officials of Jezreel.
He sent them to the elders.
He sent them to the guardians of Ahab’s sons.
Jehu gave them a message.
He said, “When you receive this letter, your master’s sons are with you.
You have chariots.
You have horses.
You have a fortified city.
You have weapons.
Choose the best and most upright son of your master.
Set him on his father’s throne.
Fight for your master’s house.”
passages.original: וּלְאַחְאָ֛ב שִׁבְעִ֥ים בָּנִ֖ים בְּשֹׁמְר֑וֹן וַיִּכְתֹּב֩ יֵה֨וּא סְפָרִ֜ים וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח שֹׁמְר֗וֹן אֶל־ שָׂרֵ֤י יִזְרְעֶאל֙ הַזְּקֵנִ֔ים וְאֶל־ הָאֹמְנִ֥ים אַחְאָ֖ב לֵאמֹֽר׃ וְעַתָּ֗ה כְּבֹ֨א הַסֵּ֤פֶר הַזֶּה֙ אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְאִתְּכֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י אֲדֹנֵיכֶ֑ם וְאִתְּכֶם֙ הָרֶ֣כֶב וְהַסּוּסִ֔ים וְעִ֥יר מִבְצָ֖ר וְהַנָּֽשֶׁק׃ וּרְאִיתֶ֞ם הַטּ֤וֹב וְהַיָּשָׁר֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י אֲדֹנֵיכֶ֔ם וְשַׂמְתֶּ֖ם עַל־ כִּסֵּ֣א אָבִ֑יו וְהִֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ עַל־ בֵּ֥ית אֲדֹנֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: But they were terrified and reasoned, “If two kings could not stand against him, how can we?”
passages.sermon:
The officials, elders, and guardians heard Jehu’s message.
They became very afraid.
They said, “Two kings could not stand against Jehu.”
They asked, “How can we stand against him?”
passages.original: וַיִּֽרְאוּ֙ מְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ הִנֵּה֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הַמְּלָכִ֔ים לֹ֥א עָמְד֖וּ לְפָנָ֑יו וְאֵ֖יךְ נַעֲמֹ֥ד אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃

passages.text: So the palace administrator, the overseer of the city, the elders, and the guardians sent a message to Jehu: “We are your servants, and we will do whatever you say. We will not make anyone king. Do whatever is good in your sight.”
passages.sermon:
The palace administrator sent a message to Jehu.
The overseer of the city also sent a message to Jehu.
The elders sent a message to Jehu.
The guardians sent a message to Jehu.
They all spoke together to Jehu.
They said, “We are your servants.
We will do whatever you tell us.
We will not make anyone king.
Do what is good in your eyes.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח אֲשֶׁר־ עַל־ הַבַּ֣יִת וַאֲשֶׁ֪ר עַל־ הָעִ֟יר וְהַזְּקֵנִים֩ וְהָאֹמְנִ֨ים אֶל־ יֵה֤וּא׀ לֵאמֹר֙ עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ אֲנַ֔חְנוּ וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ תֹּאמַ֥ר אֵלֵ֖ינוּ נַעֲשֶׂ֑ה לֹֽא־ נַמְלִ֣יךְ אִ֔ישׁ הַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינֶ֖יךָ עֲשֵֽׂה׃

passages.text: Then Jehu wrote them a second letter and said: “If you are on my side, and if you will obey me, then bring the heads of your master’s sons to me at Jezreel by this time tomorrow.” Now the sons of the king, seventy in all, were being brought up by the leading men of the city.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was the new king of Israel.
Jehu wanted to remove the family of the former king.
Jehu wrote a second letter to the leaders of Samaria.
He wrote to the palace administrator, the overseer of the city, the elders, and the guardians.
Jehu said, “If you are on my side, obey my voice.
Take the heads of your master’s sons.
Bring them to me at Jezreel by this time tomorrow.”
The sons of the king were seventy men.
The leading men of the city were raising these seventy sons.
passages.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב אֲלֵיהֶם֩ סֵ֨פֶר׀ שֵׁנִ֜ית לֵאמֹ֗ר אִם־ לִ֨י אַתֶּ֜ם וּלְקֹלִ֣י׀ אַתֶּ֣ם שֹׁמְעִ֗ים קְחוּ֙ אֶת־ רָאשֵׁי֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־ אֲדֹנֵיכֶ֔ם וּבֹ֧אוּ אֵלַ֛י כָּעֵ֥ת מָחָ֖ר יִזְרְעֶ֑אלָה וּבְנֵ֤י הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ אֶת־ גְּדֹלֵ֥י הָעִ֖יר מְגַדְּלִ֥ים אוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: And when the letter arrived, they took the sons of the king and slaughtered all seventy of them. They put their heads in baskets and sent them to Jehu at Jezreel.
passages.sermon:
The letter arrived to the leaders of the city.
The leaders took the sons of the king.
There were seventy sons.
The leaders killed all seventy sons.
They cut off their heads.
They put the heads in baskets.
They sent the baskets to Jehu.
Jehu was in Jezreel.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י כְּבֹ֤א הַסֵּ֙פֶר֙ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַֽיִּשְׁחֲט֖וּ שִׁבְעִ֣ים אִ֑ישׁ וַיָּשִׂ֤ימוּ אֶת־ רָֽאשֵׁיהֶם֙ בַּדּוּדִ֔ים וַיִּשְׁלְח֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו יִזְרְעֶֽאלָה׃

passages.text: When the messenger arrived, he told Jehu, “They have brought the heads of the sons of the king.” And Jehu ordered, “Pile them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until morning.”
passages.sermon:
Jehu was the new king of Israel.
A messenger came to Jehu.
The messenger spoke to Jehu.
The messenger said, “They have brought the heads of the king’s sons.”
Jehu gave a command.
Jehu said, “Put the heads in two piles.”
He said, “Place the piles at the entrance of the gate.”
He said, “Leave them there until morning.”
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א הַמַּלְאָךְ֙ וַיַּגֶּד־ ל֣וֹ לֵאמֹ֔ר הֵבִ֖יאוּ רָאשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר שִׂ֣ימוּ אֹתָ֞ם שְׁנֵ֧י צִבֻּרִ֛ים פֶּ֥תַח הַשַּׁ֖עַר עַד־ הַבֹּֽקֶר׃

passages.text: The next morning, Jehu went out and stood before all the people and said, “You are innocent. It was I who conspired against my master and killed him. But who killed all these?
passages.sermon:
Jehu was the new king of Israel.
The next morning, Jehu went out.
Jehu stood before all the people.
Jehu spoke to the people.
Jehu said, “You are innocent.
I conspired against my master.
I killed my master.
But who killed all these?”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֤י בַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ וַיֵּצֵ֣א וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֔ד וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם צַדִּקִ֖ים אַתֶּ֑ם הִנֵּ֨ה אֲנִ֜י קָשַׁ֤רְתִּי עַל־ אֲדֹנִי֙ וָאֶהְרְגֵ֔הוּ וּמִ֥י הִכָּ֖ה אֶת־ כָּל־ אֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: Know, then, that not a word the LORD has spoken against the house of Ahab will fail, for the LORD has done what He promised through His servant Elijah.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke against the house of Ahab.
The LORD made promises about the house of Ahab.
The LORD gave these words to His servant Elijah.
The LORD has done what He said.
Not one word from the LORD will fail.
Everything the LORD said will happen.
passages.original: דְּע֣וּ אֵפ֗וֹא כִּי֩ לֹ֨א יִפֹּ֜ל מִדְּבַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אַ֔רְצָה אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב וַיהוָ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ה אֵ֚ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּיַ֖ד עַבְדּ֥וֹ אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃

passages.text: So Jehu killed everyone in Jezreel who remained of the house of Ahab, as well as all his great men and close friends and priests, leaving him without a single survivor.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was the king of Israel.
Jehu acted in Jezreel.
Jehu killed all who remained from the house of Ahab in Jezreel.
Jehu killed all the important men of Ahab.
Jehu killed all the close friends of Ahab.
Jehu killed all the priests of Ahab.
Jehu left Ahab no survivors.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣ךְ יֵה֗וּא אֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֤ים לְבֵית־ אַחְאָב֙ בְּיִזְרְעֶ֔אל וְכָל־ גְּדֹלָ֖יו וּמְיֻדָּעָ֣יו וְכֹהֲנָ֑יו עַד־ בִּלְתִּ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר־ ל֖וֹ שָׂרִֽיד׃

passages.text: Then Jehu set out toward Samaria. At Beth-eked of the Shepherds, Jehu met some relatives of Ahaziah king of Judah and asked, “Who are you?” “We are relatives of Ahaziah,” they answered, “and we have come down to greet the sons of the king and of the queen mother.”
passages.sermon:
Jehu was a commander chosen by God to destroy the house of Ahab.
Jehu began to travel toward Samaria.
On the way, Jehu reached Beth-eked of the Shepherds.
There, Jehu met some men.
These men were relatives of Ahaziah, king of Judah.
Jehu asked them, “Who are you?”
The men answered, “We are relatives of Ahaziah.”
They said, “We have come down to greet the sons of the king.”
They also said, “We have come to greet the sons of the queen mother.”
passages.original: וַיָּ֙קָם֙ וַיָּבֹ֔א וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ שֹׁמְר֑וֹן ה֛וּא בֵּֽית־ עֵ֥קֶד הָרֹעִ֖ים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃ וְיֵה֗וּא מָצָא֙ אֶת־ אֲחֵי֙ אֲחַזְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מִ֣י אַתֶּ֑ם וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ אֲחֵ֤י אֲחַזְיָ֙הוּ֙ אֲנַ֔חְנוּ וַנֵּ֛רֶד לִשְׁל֥וֹם בְּנֵֽי־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וּבְנֵ֥י הַגְּבִירָֽה׃

passages.text: Then Jehu ordered, “Take them alive.” So his men took them alive, then slaughtered them at the well of Beth-eked—forty-two men. He spared none of them.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was the king of Israel.
Jehu met the relatives of Ahaziah, king of Judah.
Jehu gave a command.
He said, “Take them alive.”
Jehu’s men obeyed him.
They took the men alive.
There were forty-two men.
Jehu’s men killed all forty-two men at the well of Beth-eked.
Jehu did not spare any of them.
No one survived.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ תִּפְשׂ֣וּם חַיִּ֔ים וַֽיִּתְפְּשׂ֖וּם חַיִּ֑ים וַֽיִּשְׁחָט֞וּם אֶל־ בּ֣וֹר בֵּֽית־ עֵ֗קֶד אַרְבָּעִ֤ים וּשְׁנַ֙יִם֙ אִ֔ישׁ וְלֹֽא־ הִשְׁאִ֥יר אִ֖ישׁ מֵהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: When he left there, he found Jehonadab son of Rechab, who was coming to meet him. Jehu greeted him and asked, “Is your heart as true to mine as my heart is to yours?” “It is!” Jehonadab replied. “If it is,” said Jehu, “give me your hand.” So he gave him his hand, and Jehu helped him into his chariot, saying, “Come with me and see my zeal for the LORD!” So he had him ride in his chariot.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was a commander in Israel.
Jehu left that place.
He met Jehonadab son of Rechab.
Jehonadab was coming to meet Jehu.
Jehu greeted Jehonadab.
Jehu asked him a question.
Jehu said, “Is your heart honest toward me, as my heart is toward you?”
Jehonadab answered, “It is.”
Jehu said, “If it is, give me your hand.”
Jehonadab gave his hand to Jehu.
Jehu took Jehonadab up into his chariot.
Jehu said, “Come with me and see my zeal for the LORD.”
Jehu had Jehonadab ride with him in his chariot.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ מִשָּׁ֡ם וַיִּמְצָ֣א אֶת־ יְהוֹנָדָב֩ בֶּן־ רֵכָ֨ב לִקְרָאת֜וֹ וַֽיְבָרְכֵ֗הוּ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו הֲיֵ֧שׁ אֶת־ לְבָבְךָ֣ יָשָׁ֗ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר לְבָבִי֙ עִם־ לְבָבֶ֔ךָ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹנָדָ֥ב יֵ֛שׁ וָיֵ֖שׁ תְּנָ֣ה אֶת־ יָדֶ֑ךָ וַיִּתֵּ֣ן יָד֔וֹ וַיַּעֲלֵ֥הוּ אֵלָ֖יו אֶל־ הַמֶּרְכָּבָֽה׃ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לְכָ֣ה אִתִּ֔י וּרְאֵ֖ה בְּקִנְאָתִ֣י לַיהוָ֑ה וַיַּרְכִּ֥בוּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּרִכְבּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: When Jehu came to Samaria, he struck down everyone belonging to Ahab who remained there, until he had destroyed them, according to the word that the LORD had spoken to Elijah.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was a king of Israel.
Jehu came to Samaria.
Ahab was a former king of Israel.
Some people in Samaria still belonged to Ahab’s family.
Jehu struck down all who remained from Ahab’s family in Samaria.
Jehu destroyed them all.
The LORD had spoken a word to Elijah about this.
Jehu acted according to the word of the LORD spoken to Elijah.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן וַ֠יַּךְ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֧ים לְאַחְאָ֛ב בְּשֹׁמְר֖וֹן עַד־ הִשְׁמִיד֑וֹ כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר אֶל־ אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃פ

passages.text: Then Jehu brought all the people together and said, “Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him a lot.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was the king of Israel.
Jehu gathered all the people.
Jehu spoke to them.
Jehu said, “Ahab served Baal a little.
I, Jehu, will serve Baal much more.”
passages.original: וַיִּקְבֹּ֤ץ יֵהוּא֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אַחְאָ֕ב עָבַ֥ד אֶת־ הַבַּ֖עַל מְעָ֑ט יֵה֖וּא יַעַבְדֶ֥נּוּ הַרְבֵּֽה׃

passages.text: Now, therefore, summon to me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests. See that no one is missing, for I have a great sacrifice for Baal. Whoever is missing will not live.” But Jehu was acting deceptively in order to destroy the servants of Baal.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was the king of Israel.
Jehu spoke to the people.
He said, “Call all the prophets of Baal to me.
Call all the servants of Baal.
Call all the priests of Baal.
Do not let anyone be missing.
I have a great sacrifice for Baal.
Anyone who is missing will not live.”
Jehu acted with deceit.
He did this to destroy the servants of Baal.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה כָל־ נְבִיאֵ֣י הַבַּ֡עַל כָּל־ עֹבְדָ֣יו וְכָל־ כֹּהֲנָיו֩ קִרְא֨וּ אֵלַ֜י אִ֣ישׁ אַל־ יִפָּקֵ֗ד כִּי֩ זֶ֨בַח גָּד֥וֹל לִי֙ לַבַּ֔עַל כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִפָּקֵ֖ד לֹ֣א יִֽחְיֶ֑ה וְיֵהוּא֙ עָשָׂ֣ה בְעָקְבָּ֔ה לְמַ֥עַן הַאֲבִ֖יד אֶת־ עֹבְדֵ֥י הַבָּֽעַל׃

passages.text: And Jehu commanded, “Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal.” So they announced it.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was the king of Israel.
Jehu gave a command.
He said, “Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal.”
The people announced the assembly.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יֵה֗וּא קַדְּשׁ֧וּ עֲצָרָ֛ה לַבַּ֖עַל וַיִּקְרָֽאוּ׃

passages.text: Then Jehu sent word throughout Israel, and all the servants of Baal came; there was not a man who failed to show. They entered the temple of Baal, and it was filled from end to end.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was the king of Israel.
Jehu sent a message to all Israel.
He called for all the servants of Baal.
Every servant of Baal came.
No one stayed away.
They all entered the temple of Baal.
The temple of Baal became completely full.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יֵהוּא֙ בְּכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ כָּל־ עֹבְדֵ֣י הַבַּ֔עַל וְלֹֽא־ נִשְׁאַ֥ר אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ בָ֑א וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית הַבַּ֔עַל וַיִּמָּלֵ֥א בֵית־ הַבַּ֖עַל פֶּ֥ה לָפֶֽה׃

passages.text: And Jehu said to the keeper of the wardrobe, “Bring out garments for all the servants of Baal.” So he brought out garments for them.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was the king of Israel.
Jehu spoke to the keeper of the wardrobe.
Jehu said, “Bring out garments for all the servants of Baal.”
The keeper of the wardrobe brought out garments for the servants of Baal.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לַֽאֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ הַמֶּלְתָּחָ֔ה הוֹצֵ֣א לְב֔וּשׁ לְכֹ֖ל עֹבְדֵ֣י הַבָּ֑עַל וַיֹּצֵ֥א לָהֶ֖ם הַמַּלְבּֽוּשׁ׃

passages.text: Next, Jehu and Jehonadab son of Rechab entered the temple of Baal, and Jehu said to the servants of Baal, “Look around to see that there are no servants of the LORD here among you—only servants of Baal.”
passages.sermon:
Jehu was the king of Israel.
Jehonadab was the son of Rechab.
Jehu and Jehonadab entered the temple of Baal.
The temple of Baal was a place where people worshiped Baal.
Jehu spoke to the servants of Baal.
Jehu said, “Search carefully.”
He said, “See if there are any servants of the LORD here with you.”
He said, “Only servants of Baal should be here.”
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א יֵה֛וּא וִיהוֹנָדָ֥ב בֶּן־ רֵכָ֖ב בֵּ֣ית הַבָּ֑עַל וַיֹּ֜אמֶר לְעֹבְדֵ֣י הַבַּ֗עַל חַפְּשׂ֤וּ וּרְאוּ֙ פֶּן־ יֶשׁ־ פֹּ֤ה עִמָּכֶם֙ מֵעַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י אִם־ עֹבְדֵ֥י הַבַּ֖עַל לְבַדָּֽם׃

passages.text: And they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had stationed eighty men outside and warned them, “If anyone allows one of the men I am delivering into your hands to escape, he will forfeit his life for theirs.”
passages.sermon:
Jehu was the king of Israel.
Jehu wanted to destroy the worshipers of Baal.
The servants of Baal went into the temple.
They went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings.
Jehu placed eighty men outside the temple.
Jehu spoke to these eighty men.
Jehu said, “I am giving you these men to guard.”
Jehu warned them, “If any of these men escape from you, you will die in their place.”
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֕אוּ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת זְבָחִ֣ים וְעֹל֑וֹת וְיֵה֞וּא שָׂם־ ל֤וֹ בַחוּץ֙ שְׁמֹנִ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הָאִ֤ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יִמָּלֵט֙ מִן־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ מֵבִ֣יא עַל־ יְדֵיכֶ֔ם נַפְשׁ֖וֹ תַּ֥חַת נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

passages.text: When he had finished making the burnt offering, Jehu said to the guards and officers, “Go in and kill them. Do not let anyone out.” So the guards and officers put them to the sword, threw the bodies out, and went into the inner room of the temple of Baal.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was the king of Israel.
Jehu finished making the burnt offering.
Jehu spoke to the guards and the officers.
Jehu said, “Go in and kill them.
Do not let anyone escape.”
The guards and the officers killed the people with swords.
They threw the bodies out.
The guards and the officers went into the inner room of the temple of Baal.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֞י כְּכַלֹּת֣וֹ׀ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת הָעֹלָ֗ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יֵ֠הוּא לָרָצִ֨ים וְלַשָּׁלִשִׁ֜ים בֹּ֤אוּ הַכּוּם֙ אִ֣ישׁ אַל־ יֵצֵ֔א וַיַּכּ֖וּם לְפִי־ חָ֑רֶב וַיַּשְׁלִ֗כוּ הָֽרָצִים֙ וְהַשָּׁ֣לִשִׁ֔ים וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ עַד־ עִ֥יר בֵּית־ הַבָּֽעַל׃

passages.text: They brought out the sacred pillar of the temple of Baal and burned it.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was the king of Israel.
Jehu wanted to remove Baal worship from Israel.
Jehu’s men entered the temple of Baal.
They found the sacred pillar inside the temple of Baal.
They took the sacred pillar out of the temple.
They burned the sacred pillar.
passages.original: וַיֹּצִ֛אוּ אֶת־ מַצְּב֥וֹת בֵּית־ הַבַּ֖עַל וַֽיִּשְׂרְפֽוּהָ׃

passages.text: They also demolished the sacred pillar of Baal. Then they tore down the temple of Baal and made it into a latrine, which it is to this day.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was king of Israel.
Jehu destroyed the worship of Baal in Israel.
Jehu’s men demolished the sacred pillar of Baal.
Jehu’s men tore down the temple of Baal.
They made the place into a latrine.
It remains a latrine to this day.
passages.original: וַֽיִּתְּצ֔וּ אֵ֖ת מַצְּבַ֣ת הַבָּ֑עַל וַֽיִּתְּצוּ֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית הַבַּ֔עַל וַיְשִׂמֻ֥הוּ לְמַחֲרָאוֹת עַד־ הַיּֽוֹם׃

passages.text: Thus Jehu eradicated Baal from Israel, but he did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit—the worship of the golden calves at Bethel and Dan.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was king of Israel.
Jehu destroyed Baal in Israel.
Jehu removed Baal worship from the land.
Jeroboam was a former king of Israel.
Jeroboam son of Nebat led Israel into sin.
Jeroboam caused the people to worship golden calves.
The golden calves were in Bethel and Dan.
Jehu did not turn away from these sins.
Jehu continued the worship of the golden calves.
passages.original: וַיַּשְׁמֵ֥ד יֵה֛וּא אֶת־ הַבַּ֖עַל מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ רַ֠ק חֲטָאֵ֞י יָרָבְעָ֤ם בֶּן־ נְבָט֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶחֱטִ֣יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹֽא־ סָ֥ר יֵה֖וּא מֵאַֽחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם עֶגְלֵי֙ הַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּֽית־ אֵ֖ל וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּדָֽן׃ס

passages.text: Nevertheless, the LORD said to Jehu, “Because you have done well in carrying out what is right in My sight and have done to the house of Ahab all that was in My heart, four generations of your sons will sit on the throne of Israel.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jehu.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD said, “You have done what is right in My eyes.
You did everything I wanted against the house of Ahab.
Because of this, four generations of your sons will sit on the throne of Israel.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ יֵה֗וּא יַ֤עַן אֲשֶׁר־ הֱטִיבֹ֙תָ֙ לַעֲשׂ֤וֹת הַיָּשָׁר֙ בְּעֵינַ֔י כְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּלְבָבִ֔י עָשִׂ֖יתָ לְבֵ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב בְּנֵ֣י רְבִעִ֔ים יֵשְׁב֥וּ לְךָ֖ עַל־ כִּסֵּ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Yet Jehu was not careful to follow the instruction of the LORD, the God of Israel, with all his heart. He did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was king of Israel.
Jehu did not follow the instruction of the LORD.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
Jehu did not obey with all his heart.
Jehu did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam.
Jeroboam caused Israel to sin.
passages.original: וְיֵה֗וּא לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֛ר לָלֶ֛כֶת בְּתֽוֹרַת־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּכָל־ לְבָב֑וֹ לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מֵעַל֙ חַטֹּ֣אות יָֽרָבְעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: In those days the LORD began to reduce the size of Israel. Hazael defeated the Israelites throughout their territory from the Jordan eastward through all the land of Gilead (the region of Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh), and from Aroer by the Arnon Valley through Gilead to Bashan.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
In those days, the LORD began to reduce the size of Israel.
Hazael was the king of Aram.
Hazael attacked Israel.
He defeated the Israelites in all their territory.
He conquered land from the Jordan River eastward.
He took all the land of Gilead.
This land belonged to the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh.
He captured land from Aroer, which is by the Arnon Valley.
He took Gilead and Bashan.
passages.original: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם הֵחֵ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה לְקַצּ֖וֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּכֵּ֥ם חֲזָאֵ֖ל בְּכָל־ גְּב֥וּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ מִן־ הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרַ֣ח הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ אֵ֚ת כָּל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַגִּלְעָ֔ד הַגָּדִ֥י וְהָרֻאובֵנִ֖י וְהַֽמְנַשִּׁ֑י מֵעֲרֹעֵר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ נַ֣חַל אַרְנֹ֔ן וְהַגִּלְעָ֖ד וְהַבָּשָֽׁן׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Jehu, along with all his accomplishments and all his might, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
passages.sermon:
Jehu was king of Israel.
He did many things.
He showed great strength.
Other acts of Jehu are not listed here.
His accomplishments are not all described here.
His might is not fully recorded here.
These things are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
passages.original: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יֵה֛וּא וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה וְכָל־ גְּבוּרָת֑וֹ הֲלֽוֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And Jehu rested with his fathers and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoahaz reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was king of Israel.
Jehu died.
People buried Jehu in Samaria.
Jehoahaz was Jehu’s son.
Jehoahaz became king after Jehu.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יֵהוּא֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּשֹׁמְר֑וֹן וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹאָחָ֥ז בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

passages.text: So the duration of Jehu’s reign over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.
passages.sermon: Jehu was king of Israel.\r\nHe ruled in the city of Samaria.\r\nHe reigned for twenty-eight years.
passages.original: וְהַיָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָלַ֤ךְ יֵהוּא֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶֽה־ שָׁנָ֖ה בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃פ
